posts.name: Adam
posts.cooked: I actually haven’t given much dedicated thought to that, but it’s coming to me now that I do. A few of them are obvious - Ra has it on one of his cards, Absolute Zero doesn’t have a whole lot of options, Tachyon actually wears her civvies under her lab coat on Research Grant but it’s pretty much waist-up. Given the character’s origins, she’s dressed business formal almost all the time. Bunker has his fatigues, Tempest I assume has some sort of holographic normal-person camoflage, Legacy has normal street clothes (even though he’s shown in his kitchen with his costume on). Wraith does formal for social events but business casual for the day-to-day grind. I actually have no idea about Haka, Visionary, or Fanatic. I wouldn’t be surprised if Fanatic sleeps in her armor.

Having worked in an academic research setting, I think that Dr. Stinson could totally get away with those shoes. I imagine that particle physics labs are not high on chemicals/biohazards, and the shoes are closed toed so they pass OSHA. Plus, she probably spends a lot of time in meetings as she apparently has all of her funding from the feds and they love their meetings.

I imagine The Wraith wears suits with vests to the office, and my guess is that she’s not big on heels (butt kicking is severely impeded by high heels).

I call Paul Parsons as a Bill-Cosby-Sweater wearer.
